P13: female face and illustration style

constraints.requestedFaceCenters: x=13% and x=87%; quiet center x=30%-70%

visualReview.performed: Each generated image visually inspected for recognizable faces, hands, side placement, shared lighting, menu-specific scene, and no added UI/text. Encoded deliverables retain the native composition.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Asset: new replacement desktop background illustration for a Korean reading website. Create ONE finished wide landscape illustration, exactly 16:9, preferably 2560x1440. Fully opaque.
Reference roles: reference 1 is the authoritative male FACE and precise tarot illustration style, reference 2 is the authoritative female FACE and style, reference 3 is the PREVIOUS desktop scene for APPROVED camera distance, natural scale, vivid luminous palette and left/right placement only. Make a genuinely different environment, pose and scene; do not merely recolor or reuse that composition's furniture.
Keep the SAME TWO recognisable adult people: his angular long jaw, amber eyes, swept tousled chestnut hair; her refined long oval face, almond amber-brown OPEN eyes, delicate features, long chestnut waves. Faces must be clear and finely drawn, not tiny, not blurred, not changed to generic characters. Preserve tasteful adult natural proportions.
Style: highly detailed modern fantasy tarot illustration, fine confident 2D anime/manhwa outlines, precise hair strands and textile embroidery, rich luminous gold, warm ivory and jewel colors, sharp controlled shadows. Bright clear daylight matching the approved reference, original saturation, no washout, no cinematic darkness, no photo skin, no 3D, no soft airbrush.
Layout invariant: continuous physical scene with ONE shared perspective and light. Same medium-long camera distance as reference 3, full figures or knee-length with heads/shoulders complete. Male on far left with face centered x=13%, female on far right face centered x=87%; head height y=18%-30%. Figures confined mostly to x=0%-27% and x=74%-100%. Central x=30%-70% remains quiet pale architecture/floor/open air without people or important props because a website reading panel covers it. Do NOT draw the reading panel. Detail and the menu's identifying props go at the outer sides. Keep all faces safely inside frame, 4%-8% headroom. Clear eyes, calm attentive expressions toward viewer. Exactly two arms each, simple natural hands, no pinching.
Avoid: text, letters, numbers, labels, signatures, logos, watermark, tarot-card frame or decorative border around the image, phones, screens, clocks, calendars, additional people, collage, duplicated faces, split panels.

Dedicated menu: Ziwei celestial birth-chart reading.
NEW SCENE: a sunlit celestial archive with a high pale stone barrel-vault and a broad clear north-facing opening, NOT the old turquoise glass dome terrace. On the far left the male scholar sits upright on a low carved stool at a compact dark-blue/brass instrument desk, one hand resting beside a small brass astrolabe, other hand on a closed star atlas; midnight-blue tailored tunic with refined gold constellations, ivory sleeves, no fur cloak. On the far right the female scholar stands at a slender ivory lectern, gently unrolling a round star-map parchment with only small unlabelled dots and fine connections; pearl-lilac dress, dark sapphire short mantle, long original hair and a subtle gold star clasp. Tall celestial archive cabinets and brass observational instruments at extreme edges establish the topic. Center is pale sunlit floor and distant clear blue sky, no ornate central disk, no tree canopy. Preserve the existing female's long hair identity from reference 2 for this PC scene.

Dedicated menu: Traditional compatibility, comparing two people's records with care.
